blocks.en: Section 4: Regulatory Considerations, Stability & Glossary

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 結構化方法（Structured Approaches） 的適用場景：特別是未識別 ECs 的已上市產品的頻繁 CMC 變更
blocks.en: Understand when to use Structured Approaches: in particular for frequent CMC changes to marketed products without identified ECs

blocks.zh: 掌握 Q12 §9 的 穩定性數據策略：確認性穩定性研究 vs. 傳統 ICH Q1A(R2) 建立性穩定性研究的核心差異
blocks.en: Master the stability data strategy of Q12 Section 9: the core differences between confirmatory stability studies and traditional ICH Q1A(R2) stability studies that establish shelf life

blocks.zh: 了解 CMC 變更支持性穩定性研究的 五種設計工具（加速/應力試驗、比較性研究、統計評估、預測模型、歷史知識）
blocks.en: Learn the five design tools for stability studies supporting CMC changes (accelerated/stress studies, comparative studies, statistical evaluation, predictive models, prior knowledge)

blocks.zh: 能夠查閱並正確使用 Q12 詞彙表 中的關鍵術語定義
blocks.en: Be able to look up and correctly use the definitions of key terms in the Q12 Glossary

blocks.zh: 整合本節知識，了解 Q12 主要參考文獻（ICH Q1A/Q2/Q5E/Q8/Q9/Q10/Q11）的相互關係
blocks.en: Integrate the knowledge of this section and understand how the main Q12 references (ICH Q1A/Q2/Q5E/Q8/Q9/Q10/Q11) relate to one another

blocks.zh: 8. Structured Approaches for Frequent CMC Post-Approval Changes｜頻繁 CMC 變更的結構化方法
blocks.en: 8. Structured Approaches for Frequent CMC Post-Approval Changes

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 重點提示｜Annex II：分析程序變更的結構化方法示例
blocks.en: Key Point | Annex II: Example of a Structured Approach for Analytical Procedure Changes

blocks.zh: Q12 的 Annex II 提供了分析程序變更（analytical procedure changes）的具體結構化方法，包括：
blocks.en: Annex II of Q12 provides a concrete structured approach for analytical procedure changes, covering:

blocks.zh: 哪些分析程序變更類型可適用此方法（如等效的分析儀器替換、次要方法參數調整）
blocks.en: Which types of analytical procedure changes the approach can be applied to (e.g., replacement with equivalent analytical instruments, minor adjustments to method parameters)

blocks.zh: 需要生成的數據和需達到的標準
blocks.en: The data that must be generated and the criteria that must be met

blocks.zh: 適用此方法後，可採用「即時通知」或「實施後通知」而非 Prior Approval
blocks.en: Once the approach is applied, "immediate notification" or "notification after implementation" can be used instead of Prior Approval

blocks.zh: Q12 指出類似的結構化方法也可以發展應用於規模放大（scale）、包裝（packaging）等其他頻繁變更類型——這是未來監管指南發展的方向。
blocks.en: Q12 notes that similar structured approaches can also be developed for other types of frequent changes, such as scale and packaging. This is the direction of future regulatory guidance.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明｜結構化方法就像「標準化作業程序（SOP）」的監管版本
blocks.en: Analogy | A structured approach is the regulatory version of a "standard operating procedure (SOP)"

blocks.zh: 在工廠裡，SOP 允許操作員在明確的條件下執行標準操作，無需每次向主管申請。結構化方法的邏輯類似：只要你遵循監管機構事先認可的「標準流程（Structured Approach）」，達到了規定的數據標準，就可以在不需要 Prior Approval 的情況下實施特定 CMC 變更，事後通知即可。前提是你的 PQS 已經「通過審核」（有效的品質系統）。
blocks.en: In a factory, an SOP allows operators to carry out standard operations under defined conditions without asking a supervisor for permission each time. A structured approach works on a similar logic: as long as you follow the "standard process (Structured Approach)" agreed in advance with the regulatory authority and meet the specified data criteria, you can implement a specific CMC change without Prior Approval and simply notify afterwards. The precondition is that your PQS has already "passed review" (i.e., it is an effective quality system).

blocks.zh: 核心概念：結構化方法的適用對象
blocks.en: Core Concept: Who Structured Approaches Are For

blocks.zh: 結構化方法（Structured Approaches）是針對一個特殊情境而設計的工具：已上市但未在原始申請中識別 ECs 的老產品。這類產品無法使用 ECs + PACMP 的完整工具組合，但仍需要一個比每次重新全套申請更有效率的方法。
blocks.en: Structured Approaches are a tool designed for one specific situation: older products that are already marketed but had no ECs identified in the original application. Such products cannot use the full toolkit of ECs + PACMP, yet they still need a more efficient route than submitting a full application for every change.

blocks.en: Comparison:

blocks.zh: 9. Stability Data Approaches to Support the Evaluation of CMC Changes｜穩定性數據支持 CMC 變更評估的方法
blocks.en: 9. Stability Data Approaches to Support the Evaluation of CMC Changes

blocks.zh: 穩定性研究設計決策框架
blocks.en: Decision Framework for Stability Study Design

blocks.zh:
Step 1: 識別穩定性相關 CQA
  → 此 CMC 變更可能影響哪些穩定性屬性？
  → 特別關注「限制有效期限」的屬性
     （如特定降解產物、溶出度、效價）

Step 2: 選擇評估工具（可組合使用）
  ├─ 加速/應力試驗（代表性物料，可實驗室批次規模）
  │   → 快速獲得「差異化」信號
  ├─ 變更前後比較性研究
  │   → 直接比對，最直觀的證明
  ├─ 統計評估現有穩定性數據
  │   → 利用已積累的歷史數據，無需重做全套試驗
  ├─ 預測降解動力學模型
  │   → 利用機制理解進行外推推算
  └─ 科學文獻和公司既有知識
      → 借鑒同類產品或類似變更的經驗

Step 3: 決定「事前 vs. 事後確認」
  → 高風險變更：在申請中提交完整數據（事前）
  → 低風險變更：實施後繼續長期穩定性監測（事後確認）
     → 需在 PACMP 或申請中明確承諾時程
blocks.en:
Step 1: Identify stability-related CQAs
  → Which stability attributes could this CMC change affect?
  → Pay particular attention to attributes that "limit shelf life"
     (e.g., specific degradation products, dissolution, potency)

Step 2: Select evaluation tools (can be combined)
  ├─ Accelerated/stress studies (representative material, laboratory-scale batches acceptable)
  │   → Quickly obtain a "differentiating" signal
  ├─ Pre- vs. post-change comparative studies
  │   → Direct comparison, the most intuitive evidence
  ├─ Statistical evaluation of existing stability data
  │   → Use accumulated historical data without repeating the full set of studies
  ├─ Predictive degradation kinetic models
  │   → Extrapolate using mechanistic understanding
  └─ Scientific literature and company prior knowledge
      → Draw on experience from similar products or similar changes

Step 3: Decide "before vs. after" confirmation
  → High-risk changes: submit full data with the application (before)
  → Low-risk changes: continue long-term stability monitoring after implementation (after)
     → The timeline must be clearly committed in the PACMP or the application

blocks.zh: 重點提示｜確認性穩定性可以「在實施後進行」
blocks.en: Key Point | Confirmatory stability can be "performed after implementation"

blocks.zh: Q12 §9 的一個重要彈性：允許「在 CMC 變更申請中承諾進行確認性穩定性研究，而非先提交穩定性數據再獲批准」。這意味著：
blocks.en: An important flexibility in Q12 Section 9: a company may "commit in the CMC change submission to conduct a confirmatory stability study, rather than submitting stability data first and then obtaining approval". This means:

blocks.zh: 若科學評估（如加速試驗、比較性研究）已足夠支持低風險結論，可以先申請實施變更，同時承諾進行長期確認性穩定性研究
blocks.en: If scientific evaluation (e.g., accelerated studies, comparative studies) is sufficient to support a low-risk conclusion, the change can be submitted for implementation first, with a commitment to conduct long-term confirmatory stability studies

blocks.zh: 這大幅縮短了 CMC 變更的等待時間（不再需要等 24-36 個月的全套長期穩定性數據）
blocks.en: This greatly shortens the waiting time for CMC changes (there is no longer a need to wait 24-36 months for a full set of long-term stability data)

blocks.zh: 但這個彈性不是無條件的——需要充分的科學論證，且通常只適用於低風險的 EC 變更
blocks.en: However, this flexibility is not unconditional: it requires sound scientific justification and generally applies only to low-risk EC changes

blocks.zh: 比喻說明｜確認性穩定性就像「食品安全比較測試」
blocks.en: Analogy | Confirmatory stability is like a "food safety comparison test"

blocks.zh: 若一家餐廳要更換食材供應商（CMC 變更），他們不需要重新做「食品安全認證」（建立性穩定性）——那是新菜品開發時才需要的。他們只需要做「新舊食材的比較測試」，確認新食材的食安標準與原來一樣（確認性穩定性）。若比較測試顯示品質相當，就可以先換供應商，同時承諾繼續監測（長期穩定性監測作為確認）。這比每次換供應商都要重新完整認證效率高得多。
blocks.en: If a restaurant wants to change its ingredient supplier (a CMC change), it does not need to redo "food safety certification" (stability studies that establish shelf life); that is only needed when a new dish is developed. It only needs to run a "comparison test of the old and new ingredients" to confirm that the new ingredient meets the same food safety standard as before (confirmatory stability). If the comparison shows equivalent quality, it can switch suppliers first while committing to continued monitoring (long-term stability monitoring as confirmation). This is far more efficient than a full recertification each time the supplier changes.

blocks.zh: 實務應用｜CDMO 穩定性研究設計效率化
blocks.en: Practical Application | Making CDMO stability study design more efficient

blocks.zh: Q12 §9 給了 CDMO 強大的工具來優化穩定性研究成本：
blocks.en: Q12 Section 9 gives CDMOs powerful tools to optimize the cost of stability studies:

blocks.zh: 矩陣式和括號式設計：結合 ICH Q1D 的設計方法，減少所需穩定性測試點
blocks.en: Matrixing and bracketing designs: combine with the design approaches of ICH Q1D to reduce the number of stability testing points required

blocks.zh: 共享穩定性數據：若 CDMO 管理多個類似化學特性的產品，可提出「類比論證（bracketing approach）」以減少重複試驗
blocks.en: Shared stability data: if a CDMO manages several products with similar chemical properties, it can propose a "bracketing approach" justified by analogy to reduce duplicate testing

blocks.zh: 穩定性預測模型建立：投資開發產品特異性的動力學降解模型，可在未來的 CMC 變更中重複使用，降低每次變更的穩定性研究成本
blocks.en: Building stability prediction models: invest in developing product-specific kinetic degradation models that can be reused in future CMC changes, lowering the stability study cost of each change

blocks.zh: PACMP 整合：將確認性穩定性研究設計納入 PACMP，事先議定研究規模和時程，避免每次變更都重新談判穩定性要求
blocks.en: PACMP integration: build the confirmatory stability study design into the PACMP, agreeing the study scale and timeline in advance so that stability requirements do not have to be renegotiated for every change

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 若一個製劑（DP）更換了直接接觸容器（如玻璃瓶規格變更），需要做什麼穩定性評估？如何判斷是否需要在申請前還是申請後進行確認性穩定性研究？
blocks.en: If a drug product (DP) changes its primary container closure (e.g., a change in glass vial specification), what stability evaluation is needed? How do you decide whether the confirmatory stability study should be performed before or after submission?

blocks.zh: 「以實驗室批次規模而非商業批次規模進行加速試驗」——這種做法的科學前提是什麼？有什麼限制條件？
blocks.en: "Performing accelerated studies on laboratory-scale rather than commercial-scale batches": what is the scientific premise of this approach? What limitations apply?

blocks.zh: 10. Glossary｜詞彙表
blocks.en: 10. Glossary

blocks.zh: 重點提示｜「Submission」的精確含義
blocks.en: Key Point | The precise meaning of "Submission"

blocks.zh: Q12 詞彙表對 "Submission" 的定義值得特別注意：它泛指「向監管機構溝通 EC 變更的行為」，可以是 Prior Approval（需要批准後才能實施）或 Notification（通知型，不需要等待批准）。這個定義強調：並非所有 Submission 都需要監管機構「批准」才能實施——Notification 類型的 Submission 只是一個「溝通行為」，不是「許可申請」。這個區別在日常工作中非常重要，影響公司的 CMC 變更時程規劃。
blocks.en: The Q12 Glossary definition of "Submission" deserves particular attention: it refers broadly to "the act of communicating an EC change to the regulatory authority", which can be either a Prior Approval (the change may be implemented only after approval) or a Notification (a notification type that does not require waiting for approval). The definition stresses that not every Submission requires the authority's "approval" before implementation: a Notification-type Submission is only an act of "communication", not an "application for permission". This distinction is very important in day-to-day work and affects how a company plans its CMC change timelines.

blocks.zh: PQR（Product Quality Review）在 Q12 的脈絡中扮演什麼角色？它如何成為 EC 修訂觸發的「感測器」？
blocks.en: What role does the PQR (Product Quality Review) play in the context of Q12? How does it become the "sensor" that triggers EC revision?

blocks.zh: ICH Q5E（生物製品可比性）在 Q12 EC 變更評估中有什麼特殊重要性？為什麼生物製品的 EC 識別比化學藥品更複雜？
blocks.en: What special importance does ICH Q5E (comparability of biotechnological/biological products) have in evaluating EC changes under Q12? Why is EC identification for biological products more complex than for chemical drugs?

blocks.zh: 若公司打算利用 Q12 的穩定性彈性（§9）來支持某個 CMC 變更，且計畫在 PACMP 中納入這個策略，需要在 PACMP 中額外說明哪些內容？
blocks.en: If a company intends to use the stability flexibility of Q12 (Section 9) to support a CMC change and plans to include this strategy in a PACMP, what additional information must be described in the PACMP?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 結構化方法（§8）：針對未識別 ECs 的已上市老產品，提供頻繁 CMC 變更（如分析程序更新）的效率化路徑；以 Annex II 分析程序變更為示例，前提是有效的 PQS；達標後可採用即時通知或實施後通知
blocks.en: Structured Approaches (Section 8): for older marketed products without identified ECs, they provide an efficient pathway for frequent CMC changes (such as analytical procedure updates); Annex II on analytical procedure changes serves as the example, with an effective PQS as the precondition; once the criteria are met, immediate notification or notification after implementation can be used

blocks.zh: 確認性穩定性 vs. 建立性穩定性：前者（Q12 §9）目的是「確認」已核准的有效期仍適用；後者（Q1A）目的是「建立」有效期和儲存條件——兩者設計要求和數據深度不同
blocks.en: Confirmatory stability vs. stability studies that establish shelf life: the former (Q12 Section 9) aims to "confirm" that the approved shelf life remains applicable; the latter (Q1A) aims to "establish" the shelf life and storage conditions. Their design requirements and depth of data differ

blocks.zh: 穩定性研究設計五大工具：加速/應力試驗、變更前後比較性研究、統計評估現有數據、預測動力學模型、公司/文獻既有知識——可靈活組合使用
blocks.en: Five tools for stability study design: accelerated/stress studies, pre- vs. post-change comparative studies, statistical evaluation of existing data, predictive kinetic models, and company/literature prior knowledge, which can be combined flexibly

blocks.zh: 實施後確認性穩定性：低風險 CMC 變更可先實施，事後承諾完成長期穩定性監測作為確認——大幅縮短等待時間
blocks.en: Confirmatory stability after implementation: low-risk CMC changes can be implemented first, with a commitment to complete long-term stability monitoring afterwards as confirmation, greatly shortening the waiting time

blocks.zh: 詞彙精確性：Submission ≠ Prior Approval；Notification 是一種 Submission，但不需要等待批准才能實施；EC、CPP、CQA 三者的定義層次不同
blocks.en: Precision of terminology: Submission ≠ Prior Approval; a Notification is a type of Submission, but it does not require waiting for approval before implementation; EC, CPP and CQA are defined at different levels

blocks.zh: Q12 的參考生態系統：Q8（科學方法）+ Q9（風險評估）+ Q10（PQS）+ Q11（DS 開發）→ Q12（商業上市後 CMC 變更管理）是一個有機整合的框架
blocks.en: The Q12 reference ecosystem: Q8 (scientific approach) + Q9 (risk assessment) + Q10 (PQS) + Q11 (DS development) → Q12 (management of post-approval CMC changes in the commercial phase) form an organically integrated framework
